1. कूड् cl. 6. P. कूडति, to eat, graze, Dhātup. xxviii, 88;
to become firm or fat or solid, ib. (v.l. कृड्).

 (impf. अकूलयत्), AitBr. iv, 9; Kapiṣṭh. iv, 2.

n. a measure of grain or of wood or of iron &c.
